name: Glance Controls
description: Customise Glance’s buttons: position, size, order, and visibility, plus a Copy URL button.

button-order.uc.js.name: Glance Button Order
button-order.uc.js.description: Adds up/down controls beside the visibility checkboxes and applies your button order.

copy-url.uc.js.name: Copy Glance URL
copy-url.uc.js.description: Adds Copy URL and centres the visible Glance buttons at your chosen height.
